messages:
Nina (marketing): Quick sync 100 on battlecard edits for next week's webinar. Need two lean hooks: 'cost predictability' and 'ops resiliency'. Keep each <=3 bullets and add one-line objection handlers.
Omar (growth): For cost predictability lead with a concrete example: $/1k tokens for a chat workload (small, medium, large). People latch onto a dollar figure.
Priya (product): We can use last quarter's bench: small chat (512 ctx) = $0.27/1k tokens w/ caching; without caching ~ $0.65. I'll paste the CSV in the doc after this thread. eng-bench-bot will post link.
eng-bench-bot: Bench report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/benches/1799 (access: internal)
Quinn (sales): Objection line: "Why not just use cloud serverless?" -> "If your priority is predictable latency and spend for production traffic, Dedicated provides SLA-backed throughput and simplified capacity planning." Short and sharp.
Ravi (field): Routing for webinar leads: 1) cold registrants -> automated 3-email nurture; 2) clicked bench -> score +25 and follow-up case study; 3) demo request or >2 pages viewed -> immediate SDR. I'll put rules into HubSpot.
Sana (content): I'll draft two subject lines per hook + three LinkedIn blurbs. Examples: "Cut token spend 2x with smarter caching" and "Stop chasing tail latency 10". Want the $/1k numbers ASAP.
Nina (marketing): Draft bullets, updated with Priya's numbers:```
Cost predictability:
 $0.27 / 1k tokens (with prefix caching) vs $0.65 unmanaged
 Dedicated + Optimize reduces unit cost at scale and offers committed pricing
 One-line rebut: "No surprises on your invoice 10  we surface token-level charges in the Console"

Ops resiliency:
 SLA-backed Dedicated cuts 99p latency jitter by ~3x during congestion (bench)
 Smart routing + model-variant fallback keeps success rate high under regional pressure
 One-line rebut: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Models are portable; rollout controls + transparent catalog let you move models or run variants on-prem."
```
Omar (growth): Suggest swapping the cost bullets to lead with the $0.27 stat first (people want price). Also propose A/B test CTA: "See your expected token bill" vs "See latency tail reduction".
Quinn (sales): Add a quick competitor callout line for the battlecard: "Vs big cloud serverless: lower unit economics at steady throughput; Vs LLM API vendors: more deployment flex and predictable SLOs." Keep it non-named.
Priya (product): Add a small technical note for SDRs: "Enable prefix caching + continuous batching in runtime to hit the $0.27 figure; turning caching off increases cost ~2.4x in our tests."
Ravi (field): I'll map nurture cadence: Day0 bench; Day3 webinar recap; Day7 short case study; Day10 ROI invite; Day14 SDR if score>60.
Sana (content): Will share slide hooks + three email subject drafts by 4pm.
Nina (marketing): Action items: Priya paste CSV + confirm fallback stat (by noon); Sana produce subject lines + LinkedIn blurbs (by 4pm); Omar set up AB test for CTA; Ravi upload HubSpot flow. I'll assemble the battlecard doc and post link here when done. :rocket:
Quinn (sales): I'll post two one-liner openers for outreach later today.
Omar (growth): Noted  tracking events: bench-click, demo-request, webinar-attend, q&a-engage. We'll use them for routing.
eng-bench-bot: Congestion fallback test result: successful request rate improved 2.9x with variant fallback (see bench report).
Nina (marketing): Perfect. Thanks team  I'll loop back with a public draft in #docs after we merge edits.
